# QAT Toolkit: Kara David's Wish Note Test Case

## Repository Overview

This repository contains the Quality Assurance Testing (QAT) toolkit and codebase for the **Kara David's Wish Note** AI-generated web application.

### Repository Contents
* **Part A:** `testcase.txt` (This Readme file containing the test case documentation)
* **Part B:** `webapp-generation-prompt.txt` (The AI prompt used to generate the application)
* **Part C:** `test-webapp.php` (The single-file PHP web application generated by AI)

---

## Test Case Documentation

### Test Case Overview
* **Test Case ID:** TC-DataEntry-001
* **Test Case Title:** Data Entry - Valid
* **Test Case Description:** Functional Testing of Data Entry page with Backend validation using MySQL queries.
* **Preconditions:** Kara David Birthday Wishnote App is installed locally and MySQL database is pre-populated for comparison. Data entry page is accessed in latest Chrome/Firefox browser.
* **Test Data:** Five (5) valid entries containing First Name, Last Name, Government Position, and Location within their maximum character limits.
* **Status:** Passed

---
